title: Gateless Barrier, Case 9: Ch'ing-jang's Nonattained Buddha
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of this Soto Zen dharma talk is that true enlightenment or awakening is not something we need to strive for through meditation or self-improvement, but rather it's our natural state of being. This understanding challenges the idea that we must practice and work towards a specific goal in order to attain enlightenment, instead embracing the inherent perfection of reality itself. By letting go of attachments and expectations, we can find true freedom and awakening, without trying to control or achieve it through effort.
